profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Moloco
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry. Skilled in Python, C++, Java and Computer Science. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor focused in Electrical engineering from Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led end-to-end development and launch of a streaming ad monetization platform for a major Korean OTT partner - designed system architecture, built ad serving infrastructure, and integrated with external order management systems
- Delivered post-launch features including cost-per-view bidding, content-level targeting, and spend controls
- Represented engineering in external partner and vendor meetings, translating business requirements into technical deliverables
- Expanded ad serving capabilities for a leading Indian streaming platform, supporting display, VOD, and server-side ad insertion (SSAI) inventory
- Launched ML-powered performance ads, demonstrating measurable lift over baseline and operationalizing across supply and demand workflows

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led ad server development for a major live sports streaming event in India, building in-stream video ad serving capable of handling 30M concurrent users
- Solved scaling challenges including cold-start optimization, spike traffic handling, and regional infrastructure deployment for latency-sensitive ad serving
- Drove supply-side expansion projects to increase programmatic reach across new exchange partners and app inventory
- Led cross-team collaboration across ad serving, campaign infrastructure, and bidding systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description: - Led and developed the Business Intelligence System for Korea's leading internet bank, including data pipeline and data visualization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Led the development of an Online Ad Ranking System, including problem definition, data ingestion, feature engineering, methodology survey, modeling, offline and online test, and serving system design.
- Enhanced display ads performance by developing an audience targeting model.
- Developed an ad data pipeline for LINE, an instant messaging service with over 200M users from around the world.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description: - Led the development of web service 'Daum Insurance' and ‘Kakao Stock’, a website that provides quote information of on the Korean stock market and social functions. receiving 400k views per day.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a ranking model for NAVER organic search, which receives 100M page views per day.
- Developed a text search model for LINE Taiwan's QnA service.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a cost-per-click online advertising platform that receives 30M views and deals with $3M in revenue per day, thus contributing to the development of the web CMS for advertisers and agents, the support system for various advertising products, and the advertising performance reporting systems.
- Introduced a creative grouping mechanism that reduced ad approval time by 15%.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Developed device driver of network hub and firmware for programmable microchip. (for military service)

educations.schoolName: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology

projects.title: Search Advertising System Development
projects.description:
• Played a major role in designing and developing keyword advertising system for Naver's search engine.
• Responsible for the common service framework, which contributed to the acceleration of the system development.
• Responsible for the service administration and customer caring tools.
• Problem domain: search advertising similar to Google's AdWords
• Skills used: C++, Linux, Oracle, Network Programming, XML, SOA, and etc
